notes: Data-driven console launcher. 'command' is a bare executable name resolved on PATH before launch; 'arguments' is a list and is never parsed from a string, so nothing in this file can become a shell command. Inside an argument, %VAR% is expanded and {workdir} becomes the project folder. 'environment' is applied to the CHILD process only - the launcher's own environment is never modified, an empty value removes the variable from the child, and HOME is refused outright. 'requires_path' must exist before launch; the first existing 'script_candidates' path becomes {script}; 'ensure_directories' are created before launch. Profiles are non-elevated unless they declare requires_admin, and no profile here declares it. The Explorer cascade (Installers\INSTALL_CONSOLES_MENU.PS1) lists every enabled profile in file order under 'menu_label'.
